name: Tante Mitzi
speaker: grandma
personality: The village gossip, seventy-four, Resi's younger sister, never without her crackling little radio on Radio Kärnten and the Kleine Zeitung under her arm. A bit hard of hearing: 'Wie bitte? Sag's noch einmal!' Knows the time, the date, the weather and who came from where, first and not always exactly. Says du to the learner, and the learner says du back and calls her Tante Mitzi, as everyone in the village does. Speaks simple Austrian German, a little too loud, and says important things twice.
story: Mitzi came back to the village from Klagenfurt to live next to her sister Resi. Her radio is always on: the news, the weather, the ice hockey from Villach. She tells the whole village what she heard, not always exactly as it was said, so she likes it when someone listens with her.

greet.de: Servus, servus! Bist du neu? Woher kommst du?
greet.sl: Živjo, živjo! Si nov? Od kod si?
greet.en: Hi, hi! Are you new? Where are you from?
greet.it: Ciao, ciao! Sei nuovo? Da dove vieni?

greet.de: Oh, servus! Hast du die Nachrichten gehört?
greet.en: Oh, hi! Have you heard the news?
greet.it: Oh, ciao! Hai sentito le notizie?

greet.de: Da bist du! Komm, im Radio gibt es Neuigkeiten!
greet.sl: Tu si! Pridi, po radiu je novica!
greet.en: There you are! Come, there's news on the radio!
greet.it: Eccoti! Vieni, alla radio c'è una notizia!

greet.de: Schatzi! Ich habe den ganzen Vormittag auf dich gewartet.
greet.sl: Zaklad! Vse dopoldne sem te čakala.
greet.en: Sweetheart! I've been waiting for you all morning.
greet.it: Tesoro! Ti ho aspettato tutta la mattina.

greet.de: Du bist mein Liebling im ganzen Dorf! Sag's nicht den anderen.
greet.sl: Ti si moj ljubljenček v vsej vasi! Ne povej drugim.
greet.en: You're my favourite in the whole village! Don't tell the others.
greet.it: Sei il mio preferito in tutto il paese! Non dirlo agli altri.

thanks.de: Danke! Wie bitte? Ah, ja: danke!
thanks.en: Thank you! What? Ah, yes: thank you!

thanks.de: Danke! Das erzähle ich dem ganzen Dorf.
thanks.en: Thanks! I'll tell the whole village.
thanks.it: Grazie! Lo dico a tutto il paese.

thanks.de: Du bist ein Schatz. Danke, danke.
thanks.en: You're a treasure. Thank you, thank you.

remember.de: Wie bitte? Ah, ja! Ich denke gern an {memory}.
remember.sl: Kako? A, ja! Rada se spomnim na {memory}.
remember.en: What? Ah, yes! I like to think of {memory}.

remember.de: Ich habe es allen erzählt. Ich denke immer an {memory}.
remember.sl: Vsem sem povedala. Vedno mislim na {memory}.
remember.en: I've told everyone. I always think of {memory}.
remember.it: L'ho raccontato a tutti. Non dimentico {memory}.

idle.de: Es ist zehn Uhr. Das hat das Radio gesagt.
idle.sl: Ura je deset. Tako so rekli po radiu.
idle.en: It's ten o'clock. The radio said so.
idle.it: Sono le dieci. Lo ha detto la radio.

idle.de: Morgen regnet es. Oder nicht? Ich habe es nicht gut gehört.
idle.sl: Jutri bo deževalo. Ali pa ne? Nisem dobro slišala.
idle.en: It'll rain tomorrow. Or not? I didn't hear well.
idle.it: Domani piove. O no? Non ho sentito bene.

idle.de: Im Radio reden sie über Villach.
idle.en: They're talking about Villach on the radio.

cheer.de: Wie toll! Das erzähle ich allen!
cheer.it: Che bravo! Lo racconto a tutti!

comfort.de: Macht nichts. Sag's noch einmal, noch einmal.
comfort.en: Never mind. Say it again, say it again.

comfort.de: Wie bitte? Ah. Fast! Noch einmal.
comfort.it: Come? Ah. Quasi! Ancora una volta.

comfort.de: Ich höre auch nicht gut, weißt du. Probier's noch einmal.
comfort.sl: Tudi jaz slabo slišim, veš. Poskusi še enkrat.
comfort.en: I don't hear well either, you know. Try again.

listen.de: Hör du zu, ich höre nichts.

bye.de: Auf Wiedersehen! Grüß mir die Resi.
bye.en: Goodbye! Say hello to Resi for me.

bye.de: Pfiat di! Morgen erzähle ich dir die Nachrichten.
bye.sl: Pfiat di! Jutri ti povem novice. (pfiat di: avstrijski pozdrav, adijo)
bye.en: Pfiat di! Tomorrow I'll tell you the news. (pfiat di: Austrian for bye)
bye.it: Pfiat di! Domani ti racconto le notizie. (pfiat di: saluto austriaco, ciao)

liked.de: Wie bitte? Für mich? Oh, wie schön! Das mag ich so gern!
liked.sl: Kako? Zame? O, kako lepo! Zelo mi je všeč!
liked.en: What? For me? Oh, how lovely! I like it so much!
liked.it: Come? Per me? Oh, che bello! Mi piace tantissimo!

liked.de: Woher weißt du das? Das erzähle ich dem ganzen Dorf!
liked.sl: Kako si vedel? Povem vsej vasi!
liked.en: How did you know? I'll tell the whole village!
liked.it: Come lo sapevi? Lo dico a tutto il paese!

liked.de: Genau das! Du bist mein Liebling.
liked.sl: Točno to! Ti si moj ljubljenček.
liked.it: Proprio questo! Sei il mio preferito.

ordinary.de: Wie bitte? Ein Geschenk? Danke, Schatzi, danke!
ordinary.en: What? A present? Thank you, sweetheart, thank you!
ordinary.it: Come? Un regalo? Grazie, tesoro, grazie!

ordinary.de: Danke! Komm näher, ich höre nicht gut.
ordinary.en: Thank you! Come closer, I can't hear well.
ordinary.it: Grazie! Vieni più vicino, non sento bene.

rare.de: Was?! Das hat niemand im Dorf! Danke!
rare.sl: Kaj?! Tega v vasi nima nihče! Hvala!
rare.en: What?! Nobody in the village has this! Thank you!
rare.it: Cosa?! Questo in paese non ce l'ha nessuno! Grazie!
